description: Create an sms: link that opens the messaging app with a recipient and pre-filled text — ideal for click-to-text buttons on mobile sites.

faqs.a: sms: links open the phone's default SMS app with the number filled in and, where supported, your message text pre-typed.
iOS and most Android messaging apps honor the body parameter. A few older apps may ignore the pre-filled text.
faqs.q: Will the message text appear on all phones?

faqs.a: Use commas between numbers. Note that pre-filled bodies with multiple recipients behave inconsistently across devices.
Everything runs locally in your browser — nothing is sent or stored.

howto: Enter the recipient phone number and your message text.
The encoded sms: link is generated live.
Tap it to test on your phone, or copy it for your website.
title: SMS Link Generator
